reels.title: M35 ESKIZ
reels.caption:
Saving art videos isn't practicing. ✏️

Same sketchbook, two plans. One draws one page a day. One saves another art video. Day 30, an ugly drawing. Next day, she draws again. A year later: 365 pages vs 912 saved videos.

Watch the wall. Every drawing gets better.

Send this to someone with an empty sketchbook.

#drawing #art #learning #habits #practice

reels.title: M36 METBEX
reels.caption:
Every chef burned dinner once. 🍳

Same kitchen, two plans. One cooks one meal a day. One orders delivery. Day 30, burnt dinner. Next day, he cooks again. A year later: 365 meals cooked vs $4,380 on delivery.

Bad days are part of learning. Keep cooking.

Send this to someone who orders every night.

#cooking #lifeskills #habits #money #selfimprovement
